title: When Greedy Sampling Explores: KL-Regularized Contextual Bandits without Eluder-Dimension Dependence
abstract: arXiv:2609.13564v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study KL-regularized contextual bandits under both reward and preference feedback. We show that greedy sampling can achieve logarithmic regret without explicit dependence on the eluder dimension. For reward feedback, we establish an eluder-dimension-independent regret bound for a simple greedy algorithm that directly samples from the Gibbs policy induced by the estimated reward. We further extend this result to preference feedback under both the general preference and Bradley--Terry models, while also sharpening existing dimension-dependent guarantees. Our analysis reveals a trade-off between greedy sampling and upper confidence bound-style exploration: greedy sampling enjoys stronger guarantees when KL regularization is sufficiently strong, whereas additional exploration becomes preferable as the regularization weakens.

translated_title: 贪婪采样何时进行探索：无Eluder维度依赖的KL正则化上下文老虎机
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在奖励反馈和偏好反馈两种设定下的KL正则化上下文老虎机问题。我们证明贪婪采样可以在不显式依赖Eluder维度的情况下实现对数遗憾。对于奖励反馈，我们为一个简单的贪婪算法建立了与Eluder维度无关的遗憾界，该算法直接从由估计奖励诱导的Gibbs策略中采样。我们进一步将这一结果扩展到偏好反馈下的广义偏好模型和Bradley--Terry模型，同时改进了现有的维度相关保证。我们的分析揭示了贪婪采样与置信上界式探索之间的权衡：当KL正则化足够强时，贪婪采样享有更强的保证；而当正则化减弱时，额外的探索则变得更为可取。
tldr: 本文证明贪婪采样算法在KL正则化上下文老虎机中可实现与Eluder维度无关的对数遗憾界，并揭示了贪婪采样与置信上界式探索之间的权衡关系。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that greedy sampling achieves logarithmic regret without eluder-dimension dependence in KL-regularized contextual bandits, revealing a trade-off between greedy sampling and UCB-style exploration.
